query: TCFD 披露 TCFD 披露 衡量企业气候信息披露与TCFD四大支柱（治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标）的契合程度。 重点考察：披露完整性、可比性、可核验性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，0-4分) • 2分：四大支柱完整披露，指标/目标清晰，边界、方法、假设透明，信息可追溯。 • 1分：仅覆盖部分支柱，披露深度有限。 • 0分：无 TCFD 相关披露。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，0-4分) • 2分：披露覆盖 >80% 业务实体/合并范围。 • 1分：覆盖 20% - 50%。 • 0分：无有效覆盖信息。 最终得分 = 0.5×内容质量+0.5×覆盖应用 TCFD 气候相关财务披露 治理支柱 战略支柱 风险管理支柱 指标与目标 TCFD索引 气候信息披露对照 ISSB IFRS S2 TCFD Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures climate-related financial disclosures governance pillar strategy pillar risk management pillar metrics and targets TCFD index climate disclosure alignment ISSB IFRS S2 报告是否明确按TCFD或等价气候披露框架组织信息？ 治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标四大支柱是否均有披露？ 指标、目标、边界、方法或假设是否可追溯？ 披露覆盖了哪些业务实体或合并范围？ 是否提供TCFD索引表或支柱对照？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator 'TCFD 披露'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 报告是否明确按TCFD或等价气候披露框架组织信息？ 治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标四大支柱是否均有披露？ 指标、目标、边界、方法或假设是否可追溯？ 披露覆盖了哪些业务实体或合并范围？ 是否提供TCFD索引表或支柱对照？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅单点披露物理风险或转型风险而无框架映射；仅有减排目标而无治理/战略/风险管理支柱；仅提及“参考TCFD”而无实质内容；仅有场景分析而无整体支柱覆盖；区分：TCFD披露评估四大支柱整体契合与可核验性；物理/转型风险与场景分析分别是支柱下的专题内容，单独专题充分不等于TCFD整体披露充分。注意：原关键词曾误用转型风险词表，已按TCFD框架重写。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION
results.text: Ju Teng International classifies all the suppliers into different levels (A/B/C/D) by the quality of the supplier's products and services and the degree of risk involved. Ju Teng International has conducted a risk assessment based on the risk items listed in the 'Supplier's Basic Information Table'. High-risk suppliers (scores below 80) are required to provide a rectification plan and make rectification, and if the rectification is not completed within the agreed period, the audit qualification of these suppliers will be cancelled. In addition, all Production Plants of Ju Teng International have introduced new procurement categories such as moulds, auxiliary materials, and equipment to strengthen centralised management of the procurement process.

Ju Teng International has conducted a risk assessment based on the risk items listed in the 'Supplier's Basic Information Table'. High-risk suppliers (scores below 80) are required to provide a rectification plan and make rectification, and if the rectification is not completed within the agreed period, the audit qualification of these suppliers will be cancelled. In addition, all Production Plants of Ju Teng International have introduced new procurement categories such as moulds, auxiliary materials, and equipment to strengthen centralised management of the procurement process.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: Ju Teng International formulated the 'Environment-Related Substance Reduction Plan Form', which imposes strict requirements on the suppliers to ban the use of heavy metals, formaldehyde, ozone hazardous substances, radioactive substances and so on. In order to restrict suppliers from using prohibited materials or chemical substances in the production process and on the products, parts and packaging materials provided to Ju Teng International, Ju Teng International has signed the 'Environmental Protection Agreement' with suppliers. In addition, Ju Teng International performs due diligence on the source and chain of custody of the purchased minerals, and requires the suppliers to complete and sign the 'Metal Mineral Origin Survey Form' and the 'Commitment on the Non-use of Conflict Minerals' so that no conflict minerals are used in the production process and on the products. That is, whenever reasonably possible, the products manufactured do not contain minerals such as gold, tantalum, tin and tungsten from armed groups abusing human rights in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or its neighbouring countries/regions.

results.text: Ju Teng International always encourages each Production Plant to fully utilise its own advantages and resources to develop and build new energy projects such as photovoltaic power generation. During the Reporting Period, the Compal Production Plant continued to utilise the unused vacant land and roof of the plant for photovoltaic power generation. In 2021, 11,890 MWh of photovoltaic power was generated, saving 1,462 tons of coal equivalent. RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION / Emission reduction

[Content]
Ju Teng International attaches importance to the treatment and discharge of the three wastes, and strictly complies with the 'Laws and Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Prevention and Control of Atmospheric Pollution', the 'Law of the People's Republic of China on Water Pollution Control', the 'Law of the People's Republic of China on the Prevention and Control of Environmental Noise Pollution', the 'Law of the People's Republic of China on the Prevention and Control of Environmental Pollution by Solid Waste' and other laws, regulations and local policies to control the generation and discharge of pollutants of the Group.
